title: RViz에서 찍은 점으로 경로 만들기
use: 섹터 4개의 촬영 위치 좌표를 처음 모을 때
limits: 실행할 때마다 RViz 입력에 의존하고 좌표가 저장되지 않음. 찍은 좌표를 섹터 ID와 함께 설정 파일로 고정해야 함
code:

import rclpy

from turtlebot4_navigation.turtlebot4_navigator import TurtleBot4Directions, TurtleBot4Navigator


def main():
    rclpy.init()

    navigator = TurtleBot4Navigator()

    # Set goal poses
    goal_pose = navigator.createPath()

    if len(goal_pose) == 0:
        navigator.error('No poses were given, exiting.')
        exit(0)

    # Start on dock
    if not navigator.getDockedStatus():
        navigator.info('Docking before intialising pose')
        navigator.dock()

    # Undock
    navigator.undock()

    # Set initial pose
    initial_pose = navigator.getPoseStamped([0.0, 0.0], TurtleBot4Directions.NORTH)
    navigator.clearAllCostmaps()
    navigator.setInitialPose(initial_pose)

    # Wait for Nav2
    navigator.waitUntilNav2Active()

    # Navigate through poses
    navigator.startFollowWaypoints(goal_pose)

    # Finished navigating, dock
    navigator.dock()

    rclpy.shutdown()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
